notablePrerequisites: Adarkar Valkyrie does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Adarkar Valkyrie by tapping it, targeting another creature you control.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing the creature targeted in step 1.
When the creature dies, Adarkar Valkyrie triggers, returning the sacrificed creature to the battlefield.
When the creature enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability
Repeat.
